variants.title: Boots, Not Boats
variants.premise: He's crouched under the pier, sorting fish scraps into a sack.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance you know how to get a boat out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Boats aren't my trade. Boots are.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: That's not what I meant.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Crew boots. I know who's ashore without looking.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: That's not helping me leave.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Never said it would.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The shark boat. Never shorts me on scraps.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tried that once. Never again.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: What happened to you?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Boots. Someone else's, in my ribs.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Good. Fewer questions for me.

options.label: Do you get lonely under here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Gulls don't ask questions.

variants.title: Watching the Gangplank
variants.premise: He's leaning on a piling at dusk, watching a ship dock.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is there any way to get a boat out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You running from something?

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: No. I just want off this coast.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That's what they all say.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He watches the gangplank a moment longer.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Deckhands, mostly. Same words every time.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Never met one who was.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Fair enough. Not looking for one myself.

options.label: Just tell me what you know.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I know boots. Crews. Who's short-tempered before noon.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: That's all you know?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That's plenty, some days.

variants.title: A Second Look
variants.premise: He's under the pier when he spots the quiver on your back.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Do you know how I could get a boat out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not from me. That thing on your back might.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: You know what this is?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Colosseum prize. Take it to the harbour, up in the capital.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He nods inland, north.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Me? No. Watched men limp back from it, though.

options.label: Why can't you help me sail?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No standing with the crews. Never have.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't thank me. Thank whoever gave you that.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You'll want better boots than those.
